title: Squirrel Helmet
desc: A sturdy acorn helmet worn proudly by forest squirrels — now yours to try. Slip it on and feel a light sprinkle of luck fall over you, as if the woodland spirits themselves are on your side.

title: Brew Buddy
desc: A cheerful little teapot who’s always ready to lend a spout. With its gentle steam and warm company, your cooking skills get a tasty boost — and your health gets a comforting +5. Perfect for cozy kitchens and rainy afternoons.

title: McLampface
desc: A charming retro lamp with a warm golden glow that can brighten both your room and your spirits. Switch it on, and it’s like flipping the mood to “cozy and inspired.”

title: Cherry Bliss
desc: A slice of cherry pie so perfect, it’s worth slowing down for. It calms the caffeine jitters, adds a sweet extra to your snack stash, and leaves you with a warm, happy glow that lingers long after the last bite.

title: Fluff Fuel
desc: A cozy cup of hot cocoa topped with a cloud of marshmallows. One sip wraps you in warmth, melts away worries, and lifts your mood like steam rising into the winter air.

title: Nap Trap
desc: A soft checkered blanket that lures you into “just a quick rest” — which somehow turns into a full nap. You wake up healthier, happier, and cozier… though a couple of snacks mysteriously vanish in the process.

title: Hug & Roll
desc: A warm, gooey cinnamon roll that feels like an edible hug. With every bite, a little swirl of luck seems to wrap around you — soft, sweet, and just sticky enough to keep the good vibes close.

title: Tales of Glenmar
desc: An old, well-worn book filled with the legendary recipes and whimsical food stories of the Glenmar Kingdom. Reading it boosts your cooking skills instantly — but you might find yourself snacking more than you planned while turning its pages.

title: Tim Froggucion
desc: Tim Froggucion is a small, cozy-hearted frog who lives for the golden days of autumn. He spends his time hopping through piles of crisp leaves, collecting shiny acorns, and sipping his all-time favorite drink — a frothy mosquito cappuccino. For Tim, fall isn’t just a season, it’s a lifestyle.

title: Wolly Polly
desc: Wolly Polly is an autumn-loving Polly who finds pure joy in knitting, stitch by stitch. Wrapped in a cozy scarf of her own making, she spends her days surrounded by yarn, crafting warmth and comfort into every loop. For her, each click of the needles is a little piece of fall magic.

title: Mr. SnapChew
desc: Mr. SnapChew is a charming autumn enthusiast with a passion for capturing the season’s beauty. Armed with his trusty camera, he roams through golden forests, snapping photo after photo of crisp leaves, warm light, and fleeting fall moments — and maybe sneaking a snack or two along the way.

title: Petunia Spookworth
desc: Petunia Spookworth is a gentle autumn ghost with a green thumb — or perhaps a green wisp. She drifts quietly through gardens, lovingly replanting flowers so they can bloom even brighter next season. Some say you can spot her by the trail of fallen petals and the faint scent of damp earth in the crisp autumn air.

title: Shroomlet Shuffle
desc: A cluster of suspiciously wobbly mushrooms balancing on thin, shaky stems. Somehow, their quirky little dance chases away your fear of reflections and leaves you in a surprisingly good mood — though their unsettling vibe might throw off your cooking game.

title: Sticky Treasure
desc: A jar of rich cherry jam that tastes best when stolen from the pantry in the middle of the night. Sweet, sticky, and a little rebellious — it restores your health like a spoonful of liquid comfort.

title: Soupernova
desc: A steaming bowl of alphabet soup that might… just might… be talking to you. The little pasta letters swirl into mysterious messages, offering comfort, encouragement, or unsettlingly accurate advice. Either way, it warms you from the inside out and leaves you healthier than before.

title: Torchmallow
desc: A campfire-perfect branch holding two golden, toasty marshmallows. Use it to link two characters together for a shared adventure — or just enjoy the sweet, gooey alliance it creates.
